verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, and such products could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no public API reference or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The documented MCP support is client-side, letting Shortwave's AI connect to other servers, and does not count as an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
